gloss: to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter

definitions.gloss: to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter; to laugh boldly
definitions.explanation: To laugh in a big, bold, uninhibited way. Implies a spirited, generous personality.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}った。
{社長|しゃちょう}は{冗談|じょうだん}を{聞|き}いて{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: The company president heard the joke and laughed heartily.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昔話|むかしばなし}をしながら{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}う{人|ひと}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was the kind of person who would roar with laughter while telling old stories.

notes:
A common expression that pairs the na-adjective {豪快|ごうかい} (bold, hearty) with {笑|わら}う (to laugh). The combination evokes a warm, open, unrestrained laugh — often associated with older men or people with big personalities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}い{飛|と}ばす: to laugh something off boldly
- {豪快|ごうかい}な{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}: a hearty laugh (as a sound)
- {豪快|ごうかい}な{笑|わら}い: a bold laugh

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大笑|おおわら}いする: to laugh loudly — emphasizes volume
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}する: to burst out laughing — more sudden, often in response to comedy
- {豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}う suggests a personality trait more than a single reaction; the laughter is characteristically bold and unguarded
